name: self-modify
description: Proposes and applies patches to SAOM's own sub-skills and SKILL.md based on recurring failure patterns. Archives originals for rollback. User approval required before any modification.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: 'propose' to scan failures and generate patches, 'apply' to apply a proposal, 'rollback' to undo a modification, 'history' to list past modifications

inputs.name: proposal_id
inputs.description: Proposal ID from propose output (for mode=apply)

inputs.name: target_file
inputs.description: File path (for mode=rollback: which file to restore)
